info.title: Certigo Enterprise Identity
info.description: Contract-only, dormant enterprise domain, abstract federation, and SCIM 2.0 surface. Runtime supports off only; no provider or live resource is configured.

x-certigo-security.adminActor: validated bearer resolved to an existing Person and active owner/admin Membership
x-certigo-security.scimActor: constant-time token hash match resolving exactly one Organization and active generation
x-certigo-security.organizationSource: credential context exact-matched to route and every loaded document

x-certigo-idempotency.exactReplay: reproduce recorded outcome without repeating effects
x-certigo-idempotency.receipts: durable request hashes; no request body or PII

oidcVerification: HTTPS discovery and issuer pinned to the active configuration generation
single-use code and subject replay receipt
samlVerification: metadata and issuer pinned to the active configuration generation
signed response or assertion with algorithm allow-list
exact audience, destination, recipient and InResponseTo
x-certigo-federation.identitySubjectSource: validated OIDC sub or SAML persistent/unspecified NameID only; never email or display name

x-certigo-scim.deprovisioning: soft organization access revocation; Person and personal learning preserved

get.summary: Describe the future Enterprise Identity V1 feature contract

200.description: Future metadata response; unreachable while the only accepted mode is off.

post.summary: Reserve a normalized domain hash and return a DNS challenge value once

201.description: Pending challenge; challenge value is returned once and only its hash is persisted.

200.description: Challenge state without the challenge value.

delete.summary: Revoke a pending challenge and release its domain claim by compare-and-set

post.summary: Resolve DNS server-side and transition a pending challenge under ETag

410.description: Challenge expired; claim release remains CAS and does not transfer ownership.

delete.summary: Revoke a verified domain without transferring it

204.description: Domain revoked and global hash claim released idempotently.

put.summary: Create a new provider-neutral configuration generation

200.description: Configuration generation stored. Active requires a verified domain.

204.description: Federation disabled idempotently; no Person or personal learning is deleted.

post.summary: Bind an explicit external subject to an existing Person as a LinkedIdentity
post.description: Owner/admin ceremony only. Email, SCIM userName, displayName, and externalId are not accepted as proof. A successful authenticated federation may invoke the same domain operation without this admin route.

201.description: LinkedIdentity created or exact replay; raw external subject is not returned.

post.summary: Generate a SCIM bearer and return plaintext once

201.description: Plaintext bearer returned once. Only its cryptographic hash is persisted.

post.summary: Generate the next token generation with a bounded overlap

200.description: New plaintext returned once; previous generation remains valid only until overlapEndsAt.

204.description: All active/overlap generations for this token family revoked.

post.description: Creates an organization directory User only. It never creates or merges a Person from email, userName, displayName, or externalId.

patch.description: active=false soft-deprovisions organization access before cleanup and preserves Person and personal learning.

delete.description: Soft-deprovisions the enterprise directory User; Person and personal learning remain.

204.description: Organization access revoked before asynchronous idempotent cleanup.

post.description: Creates an organization-scoped directory Group. Team edges are projected only for bound active Memberships.

204.description: Group and organization-owned projected edges soft-deleted idempotently.

adminBearer.description: Validated Person bearer; active owner/admin Membership is reloaded server-side.

scimBearer.description: Opaque token returned once. Only a constant-time comparable hash and generation metadata are persisted.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Organization-scoped durable receipt key. Exact replay is safe; payload mismatch is 409.

domain.description: Normalized server-side. It is never identity proof and is never written to audit.

value.description: Returned once; only a SHA-256 hash is persisted.
Returned once; only a SHA-256 hash is persisted.

clientId.description: Public audience identifier, not a secret.

personId.description: Existing Person selected explicitly; never derived from email.

externalSubject.description: Explicit immutable provider subject; normalized and hashed before persistence outside LinkedIdentity.

label.description: Administrative label; never emitted to audit.

bearerToken.description: Returned once. No plaintext recovery endpoint exists.

value.description: Mutable directory attribute only; never an identity or merge key.

externalId.description: Idempotent directory correlation only; never federation proof.

userName.description: Mutable directory attribute only; never resolves a Person.

detail.description: Generic only; never identifies another Organization or credential.

SurfaceDisabled.description: Not found. ENTERPRISE_IDENTITY_V1 is checked before authentication, body read/parsing, DNS, or repository access.

MaskedNotFound.description: Not found. Also masks feature-off, unknown Organization, absent Membership, invalid credential, and cross-tenant mismatch.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated active Membership exists but its server-side role is insufficient.

Conflict.description: Idempotency payload mismatch, replay, challenge state, takeover reservation, or ETag conflict.

ScimList.description: SCIM ListResponse confined to the token Organization.

ScimMaskedNotFound.description: SCIM 404 masking feature-off, token failure, unknown Organization/resource, and cross-tenant mismatch.

ScimConflict.description: SCIM 409 for uniqueness, idempotency payload mismatch, replay, or ETag conflict.
